links.outcome: Reading grade level (Flesch-Kincaid) of GPT-4 psychoeducational responses
links.effect: Mean FKGL 15.59 ± 1.59, indicating increased reading complexity for patients, caregivers and relatives.
links.quote: A descriptive linguistic analysis showed that responses were written at a relatively high Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL) (mean = 15.59 ± 1.59), indicating increased reading complexity.

screen.reason: Expert evaluation of GPT-4 generated responses to 20 psychoeducation questions for psychosis patients and caregivers; evaluates raw model outputs without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
